episodes.title: Russell Brand's Yoga Classmate Speaks Out: "He Was Hilarious.Then He Took Over"
episodes.description:
Before Russell Brand was talking about finding God, he was talking about healing from addiction in a Kundalini yoga class in Los Angeles. Anne Philippi, then a GQ reporter, sat next to him nearly every morning. She thought he was hilarious. She also watched him go from being another person in the class to the reason everyone waited to start.

I spoke with Anne about what she calls spiritual narcissism, and why it can be so hard to spot when everyone involved believes they’re there to get better. We talk about what happens when people are told their discomfort is part of the healing process, why people keep making excuses for someone they find charismatic, and what Anne recognized when she watched Brand talk about his conversion to Christianity years later.

Read Anne’s essay in *The New Health Club*: https://thenewhealthclub.substack.com/p/i-sat-next-to-russell-brand-on-a

episodes.title: "He Was Predatory, Very Self-Aware" — Russell Brand's Former Friend Speaks Out
episodes.description:
How did someone like Russell Brand become so powerful, and why were so many people willing to overlook what was — at least in retrospect — hiding in plain sight?

To explore the mercurial rise of Brand and understand his extraordinary magnetism, I sat down with author and cultural commentator Daniel Pinchbeck, who knew Brand personally for over a decade and helped shape his transformation from outrageous comedian into left-wing political revolutionary. In the interview, we discuss what Pinchbeck saw behind the scenes, the deeply misogynistic British culture that produced Brand, and his eventual descent into conspiracy theories, MAGA politics and evangelical Christianity. We also explored the darker side of charisma and spirituality, and whether Brand’s endless reinventions were genuine, or simply it was part of his insatiable appetite for fame, money and power.
